title: Periodic Expansion
description: Adds elements from the periodic table into Minecraft.
body:
🔬 **Periodic Expansion**

Periodic Expansion is a Minecraft mod that aims to bring the Periodic Table of Elements into the game in a meaningful and expandable way.
Instead of adding random materials, this mod focuses on real chemical elements, their properties, and how they can be translated into Minecraft gameplay.

The project is designed to be educational, immersive, and progression-friendly, making it suitable for both survival gameplay and modpacks.

⚙️ **Current Features**

🧪 New Elements

The mod currently introduces the following elements:

Lithium (Li)

Beryllium (Be)

Each element is implemented as a new ore, found naturally in the world and processed into usable materials.

⛏️ Ores & Materials

Lithium Ore

Beryllium Ore

Refined Lithium Ingots

Refined Beryllium Ingots

These resources integrate into the vanilla mining progression and are balanced for survival gameplay.

🛡️ Equipment & Gear

Both Lithium and Beryllium can be used to craft full equipment sets, including:

Tools (Pickaxe, Axe, Shovel, Sword, Hoe)

Armor (Helmet, Chestplate, Leggings, Boots)

Each material has its own stats and characteristics, inspired by real-world properties:

Lithium: Lightweight, fast tools, lower durability

Beryllium: Stronger, more durable, suitable for mid-game progression

🌍 World Integration

Ores spawn naturally in the Overworld

Spawn rates are carefully adjusted to avoid clutter and maintain balance

Compatible with vanilla terrain generation

🎯 Design Goals

Stay faithful to real chemical elements

Expand Minecraft’s material progression in a logical way

Provide a foundation for future content such as:

More elements

Element-based biomes

Special effects and reactions

Advanced crafting systems

🚧 Planned Features

The mod is actively developed, and planned additions include:

More elements from the periodic table

Element-themed biomes

Unique mechanics based on chemical properties

New mobs and environmental interactions

(Planned features are subject to change.)

📦 Compatibility

Designed for survival gameplay

Modpack-friendly

No vanilla features are overwritten

🧠 Why Periodic Expansion?

Periodic Expansion is not just about adding new ores — it is about building a systematic and expandable chemistry-based progression inside Minecraft.

If you enjoy mods that add depth, logic, and long-term expansion potential, this mod is for you.
